title.zh: 卷327 列傳一百十四 刘藻 杨应琚 杨重英 苏尔相 明瑞
title.en: Volume 327 Biographies 114: Liu Zao, Yang Yingju, Yang Zhongying, Su Erxiang, Ming Rui
title.raw: 卷327 列傳一百十四 刘藻 杨应琚 杨重英 苏尔相 明瑞

sentences.zh: =劉藻=劉藻，字素存，山東菏澤人。

translations.literal: =Liu Zao= Liu Zao, styled Sucun, was a native of Heze in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zao, whose style was Sucun, came from Heze in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 初名玉麟，以舉人授觀城教諭，乾隆元年，薦舉博學鴻詞，試一等，授檢討，更名。

translations.literal: His original name was Yulin; as a juren he was appointed instructor at Guancheng; in the first year of Qianlong he was recommended for the Bosue Hongci examination, placed in the first class, appointed reviser, and changed his name.
translations.idiomatic: He was first named Yulin. After obtaining his juren degree he became an instructor at Guancheng. In the first year of the Qianlong reign he was nominated for the special examination in erudite learning and polished composition, ranked in the top class, and appointed a Hanlin reviser, at which time he changed his name.

sentences.zh: 累遷左僉都御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in due course to the post of Left Assistant Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 圓明園工興，疏言：「園工不過少加補葺，視前代飾臺榭之觀者度越何啻萬萬？

translations.literal: When work on the Old Summer Palace began, he memorialized, saying: "The palace works amount to no more than minor repairs and patching—how can they be compared with the extravagance of past dynasties that adorned terraces and towers? The difference is not merely ten thousandfold.
translations.idiomatic: When construction at the Old Summer Palace was undertaken, he submitted a memorial saying, "These works are only minor repairs and patching. Compared with past dynasties that lavished ornament on terraces and towers, the difference is beyond measure.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為奢靡之漸，不可稍開。

translations.literal: Your servant is foolish and believes that the first step toward extravagance must not be opened even slightly.
translations.idiomatic: I am convinced that we must not open even the slightest door to extravagance.

sentences.zh: 乞皇上慎始慮終，為天地惜物力，為國家培元氣，來歲諸工酌量停減。

translations.literal: I beg Your Majesty to be careful at the beginning and thoughtful to the end, to spare material resources for Heaven and earth, to nurture the vital energy of the state, and next year to reduce the various works as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to be prudent at the outset and far-sighted at the close, to conserve the empire's material resources and nurture its vital strength, and next year to scale back the various projects as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」上嘉納。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor commended the advice and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 遷通政使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Commissioner of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 六年，擢內閣學士。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was promoted to Grand Secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 督江蘇學政。

translations.literal: He supervised education in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: He served as educational commissioner for Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 尋以高郵諸生求賑而閧，左授宗人府府丞。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, because students at Gaoyou rioted while seeking relief, he was demoted to Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan Court.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, when students at Gaoyou rioted while petitioning for famine relief, he was demoted to Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan Court.

sentences.zh: 藻居揚州候代，有吳之黼者，以文求教，藻行，饋糟魚，受之，中途發視，得白金四百，藻畀兩淮運使硃續晫還之黼。

translations.literal: While Zao was staying in Yangzhou awaiting his replacement, a certain Wu Zhiwen sought instruction in letters from him; when Zao departed, Zhiwen presented pickled fish, which he accepted; midway he opened it and found four hundred taels of silver; Zao handed them to Zhu Xuzhuo, transport commissioner of the Two Huai, to return to Zhiwen.
translations.idiomatic: While Liu was in Yangzhou awaiting transfer, a man named Wu Zhiwen asked him for literary instruction. When Liu left, Wu gave him a gift of pickled fish, which he accepted. On the road he opened it and found four hundred taels of silver inside. Liu entrusted them to Zhu Xuzhuo, transport commissioner of the Two Huai, to return to Wu.

sentences.zh: 上聞，諭曰：「如此方不愧四知！

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard of it, he instructed, saying: "Only thus is one worthy of the Four Knowings!
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard of this, he remarked, "Only in this way does one live up to the Four Knowings!

sentences.zh: 」旋乞養歸。

translations.literal: " He soon requested leave to return home and care for his parents.
translations.idiomatic: " He soon asked leave to return home and support his parents.

sentences.zh: 孝賢皇后及長皇子定安親王喪，藻詣闕入見。

translations.literal: At the mourning for Empress Xiaoxian and for the eldest imperial son, Prince Ding'an, Zao came to the capital to be received in audience.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Xiaoxian and the eldest imperial son, Prince Ding'an, died, Liu came to court for an audience.

sentences.zh: 會大學士張廷玉乞歸失上指，因獎藻，謂其知君臣休戚相關大義，以媿廷玉，加藻內閣學士銜，賜人葠二斤，命歸養母。

translations.literal: It happened that Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu's request to retire had missed the Emperor's intent; the Emperor therefore praised Zao, saying he understood the great principle that ruler and minister share weal and woe, to shame Zhang Tingyu; he added to Zao the title of Grand Secretary, bestowed two jin of ginseng, and ordered him to return and care for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Grand Secretary Zhang Tingyu's request to retire had displeased the Emperor. The Emperor therefore praised Liu, saying he understood how ruler and minister share fortune and misfortune alike, and used him to shame Zhang. He gave Liu the additional title of Grand Secretary, presented two jin of ginseng, and ordered him home to care for his mother.

sentences.zh: 母喪終，二十一年，授陝西布政使。

translations.literal: When his mother's mourning ended, in the twenty-first year he was appointed Shaanxi provincial administration commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: After his mother's mourning period ended, in the twenty-first year he was appointed provincial administration commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，擢雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was promoted to governor of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 加太子少保，兼領貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: He was given the additional title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and concurrently governed Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and concurrently held the governorship of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，例行大計，巡撫圖爾炳阿未至，藻疏請先期舉行，上嘉之，旋授雲貴總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, at the regular grand assessment, Governor Tuerbing'a had not yet arrived; Zao memorialized asking that it be held early; the Emperor commended this, and soon afterward appointed him Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, at the regular grand assessment of officials, Governor Tuerbing'a had not yet arrived. Liu memorialized asking that the assessment be held ahead of schedule. The Emperor approved, and soon afterward appointed him governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 三十年，疏言：「年來木梳野匪與緬甸所屬木邦構釁，又與耿馬土司毗連。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year he memorialized, saying: "In recent years the Mushu bandits have clashed with Mobang, subject to Burma, and also border on the Gengma native chieftaincy.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year he memorialized, saying, "In recent years the Mushu bandits have come into conflict with Mobang, which belongs to Burma, and also adjoin the Gengma native chieftaincy.

sentences.zh: 自木邦至滾弄江，應設卡防守，請於各土司就近派撥。

translations.literal: From Mobang to the Gunong River, barrier posts should be set for defense; he requested that each native chieftaincy dispatch men from nearby.
translations.idiomatic: From Mobang to the Gunong River, barrier posts ought to be established for defense. He asked that each native chieftaincy supply men from the nearest districts.

sentences.zh: 」詔如所請。

translations.literal: " An edict approved his request.
translations.idiomatic: " The throne approved his request.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，移湖廣總督，未行，尋奏：「副將趙宏榜等赴孟連、耿馬剿逐莽匪，鎮臣烏爾登額赴滾弄江口。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to Huguang governor-general but had not yet departed when he soon memorialized: "Vice Commander Zhao Hongbang and others went to Menglian and Gengma to pursue and drive out the Mang bandits; the frontier commander Wu Erdenge went to the mouth of the Gunong River.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year he was transferred to governor-general of Huguang but had not yet left when he memorialized, "Vice Commander Zhao Hongbang and others have gone to Menglian and Gengma to pursue and expel the Mang bandits, and frontier commander Wu Erdenge has gone to the mouth of the Gunong River.

sentences.zh: 臣於普洱、思茅各隘調度。

translations.literal: Your servant is directing operations at the passes of Pu'er and Simao.
translations.idiomatic: I am directing operations at the passes of Pu'er and Simao.

sentences.zh: 」又奏言：「由小猛崙進攻九龍江、橄欖壩諸寨，多斬獲。

translations.literal: " He also memorialized, saying: "Advancing from Xiaomenglun to attack the stockades along the Jiulong River and Ganlanba, many were beheaded or captured.
translations.idiomatic: " He also reported that troops advancing from Xiaomenglun against the stockades along the Jiulong River and Ganlanba had killed or captured many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 惟參將何瓊詔、游擊明浩派赴整控江防禦，冒昧渡江，遇賊敗沒。

translations.literal: Only Colonel He Qiongshao and Brigade Commander Ming Hao, sent to defend along the Zhengkong River, rashly crossed the river and, encountering the bandits, were defeated and lost.
translations.idiomatic: Only Colonel He Qiongshao and Brigade Commander Ming Hao, dispatched to defend the Zhengkong River line, rashly crossed the river, met the enemy, and were defeated with heavy losses.

sentences.zh: 」尋奏瓊詔等未死，請治貪功輕進之罪，上以「瓊詔、明浩等遇賊敗逃，又復妄言敗沒。

translations.literal: " He soon memorialized that Qiongshao and the others were not dead and asked that the crime of greed for merit and rash advance be punished; the Emperor said, "Qiongshao, Ming Hao, and the others fled after defeat and then falsely reported themselves lost.
translations.idiomatic: " He soon reported that Qiongshao and the others were not dead and asked that they be punished for greed for merit and reckless advance. The Emperor said, "Qiongshao, Ming Hao, and the others fled after defeat and then falsely reported that they had been killed.

sentences.zh: 此法所難宥，藻反稱冒昧貪功輕進，何憒憒乃爾」？

translations.literal: By law this is hard to pardon, yet Zao instead calls it rash advance from greed for merit—how muddled can he be?"
translations.idiomatic: By law this is scarcely pardonable, yet Liu instead speaks of rash advance born of greed for merit. How muddled can he be?"

sentences.zh: 詔言：「藻本書生，軍行機宜，非其所習，朕不責以所不能。

translations.literal: An edict said: "Zao was originally a scholar; military operations are not what he is practiced in, and We do not blame him for what he cannot do.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Liu was originally a scholar. The conduct of campaigns is not what he has been trained in, and We do not blame him for what he cannot do.

sentences.zh: 至調度賞罰，並可力為籌辦，乃舛謬若此，豈堪复勝總督之任？

translations.literal: But deployment, rewards, and punishments he could have managed with full effort—yet he has been so wildly mistaken; how can he again bear the post of governor-general?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet deployment, rewards, and punishments he could have managed diligently—and he has blundered so badly. How can he again bear the post of governor-general?"

sentences.zh: 」因左授湖北巡撫，命楊應琚往代。

translations.literal: He was therefore demoted to Hubei governor, and Yang Yingju was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: He was therefore demoted to governor of Hubei, and Yang Yingju was ordered to replace him.

sentences.zh: 复諭：「應琚未至，藻當實力經理。

translations.literal: The Emperor again instructed: "Before Yingju arrives, Zao must manage affairs in earnest.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor again instructed, "Before Yingju arrives, Liu must manage affairs in earnest.

sentences.zh: 若自以為五日京兆，致誤事機，必重治其罪！

translations.literal: If he thinks himself a five-day magistrate and thereby misses the moment for action, his crime will be severely punished!"
translations.idiomatic: If he treats himself as a magistrate with only five days left in office and thereby misses the moment for action, he will be severely punished."

sentences.zh: 」部議奪職，留雲南效力。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated stripping his office, but he was retained in Yunnan to serve.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry recommended stripping his rank, but he was kept in Yunnan to serve.

sentences.zh: 藻聞上怒，惶迫自殺，巡撫常鈞疏報。

translations.literal: When Zao heard of the Emperor's anger, in panic he killed himself; Governor Chang Jun reported by memorial.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu heard of the Emperor's anger, he killed himself in panic. Governor Chang Jun reported this by memorial.

sentences.zh: 上令應琚至普洱，為求醫治療，傷平，傳旨逮問。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Yingju to Pu'er to seek medical treatment for him; when the wound healed, an edict was sent to arrest and question him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Yingju to Pu'er to have him treated medically. When the wound healed, an edict was sent to arrest and question him.

sentences.zh: 常鈞旋奏藻死，上复詔責其張皇畏葸，旅襯歸葬，不得聽其家立碑書歷官事實。

translations.literal: Chang Jun soon memorialized that Zao was dead; the Emperor again issued an edict reproaching his panic and timidity, permitted only a coffin to be sent home for burial, and forbade his family to erect a stele recording his official career.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Jun soon reported that Liu had died. The Emperor again issued an edict reproaching his panic and timidity, permitted only a coffin to be sent home for burial, and forbade his family to erect a stele recording his official career.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，巡撫鄂寧奏言：「緬甸本莽瑞體之後。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year Governor E'ning memorialized, saying: "Burma is descended from Mang Ruiti.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year Governor E'ning memorialized, saying, "Burma is descended from Mang Ruiti.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，木梳頭目甕籍牙逐其酋莽打喇而自立。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong the Mushu chieftain Weng Jiaya drove out his ruler Mang Dala and established himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Qianlong the Mushu chieftain Weng Jiaya drove out his ruler Mang Dala and set himself up as ruler.

sentences.zh: 夷人遂呼緬甸為木梳，或呼緬，或呼莽，非二種也。

translations.literal: The barbarians therefore call Burma Mushu, or call it Mian, or call it Mang—they are not two different states.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen therefore call Burma Mushu, or Mian, or Mang—they are not two separate polities.

sentences.zh: =楊應琚=楊應琚，字佩之，漢軍正白旗人，廣東巡撫文乾子。

translations.literal: =Yang Yingju= Yang Yingju, styled Peizhi, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Han Military Banner, son of Guangdong Governor Wenqian.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yingju, whose style was Peizhi, was a Bannerman of the Plain White Han Military Banner and the son of Guangdong Governor Wenqian.

sentences.zh: 應琚起家任子。

translations.literal: Yingju began his career as a yinshi appointee.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju began his career through hereditary appointment.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，自員外郎出為河東道，調西寧道。

translations.literal: Early in Qianlong he left the post of vice director to become intendant of Hedong, then was transferred to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign he left the post of vice director to become intendant of Hedong, then was transferred to Xining.

sentences.zh: 巡撫黃廷桂薦其才，高宗曰：「若能進於誠而擴充之，正未可量也。

translations.literal: Governor Huang Tinggui recommended his talent; the Gaozong Emperor said: "If he can advance in sincerity and broaden it, his future cannot yet be measured.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Huang Tinggui recommended his talent. The Gaozong Emperor said, "If he can grow in sincerity and broaden it, his future cannot yet be measured.

sentences.zh: 」累遷至兩廣總督。

translations.literal: " He was promoted in succession to Governor-General of Liangguang.
translations.idiomatic: " He rose in due course to governor-general of Liangguang.

sentences.zh: 先後疏請練水師，籌軍食，修漓水、陡河堤壩，貯柳、桂、慶、梧餘鹽，皆如所請行。

translations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized requesting training of a naval force, provisioning the army, repairing the dikes of the Li and Dou Rivers, and storing surplus salt at Liu, Gui, Qing, and Wu—all were carried out as he requested.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly memorialized to train a naval force, provision the army, repair the dikes of the Li and Dou Rivers, and store surplus salt at Liu, Gui, Qing, and Wu. All were carried out as he requested.

sentences.zh: 暹羅貢使毆傷通事，其國王鞫實，擬罰鍰，遣使牒禮部。

translations.literal: A Siamese tribute envoy beat and injured a protocol officer; the Siamese king investigated the facts, proposed a fine, and sent an envoy with a note to the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: A Siamese tribute envoy beat and injured a protocol officer. The Siamese king investigated the facts, proposed a fine, and sent an envoy with a note to the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 應琚曰：「屬國陪臣無上交。

translations.literal: Yingju said: "A subject of a tributary state has nothing to present upward.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju said, "A subject of a tributary state has nothing to present upward to the court.

sentences.zh: 」好語諭遣之，稱旨。

translations.literal: " He sent them away with kind words of instruction, which pleased the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent them away with kind words of instruction, which pleased the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，移閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to governor-general of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，加太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was given the additional title Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was made Senior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，移陝甘總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to Governor-General of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was transferred to governor-general of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 疏言伊犁底定，宜先屯田，留兵五千墾特諾果爾、長吉、羅克倫。

translations.literal: He memorialized that with Yili pacified, colonization should come first; five thousand troops should be left to open fields at Tenoguo'er, Changji, and Luokelun.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that with Yili pacified, colonization should come first, and five thousand troops should be left to open fields at Tenoguo'er, Changji, and Luokelun.

sentences.zh: 復以陝、甘非一督能治，請更西安總督為川陝總督，四川總督為巡撫，甘肅巡撫為總督，上遂命應琚督甘肅，陝西提鎮受節制，進太子太師。

translations.literal: He further argued that Shaanxi and Gansu could not be governed by a single governor-general, and requested that the Xi'an governor-general be changed to Sichuan-Shaanxi governor-general, the Sichuan governor-general be reduced to governor, and the Gansu governor be raised to governor-general; the Emperor then ordered Yingju to govern Gansu with Shaanxi's commanders and brigades under his control, and promoted him to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: He further argued that Shaanxi and Gansu could not be governed by one governor-general alone. He asked that the Xi'an governor-general become governor-general of Sichuan and Shaanxi, the Sichuan governor-general be reduced to provincial governor, and the Gansu governor be raised to governor-general. The Emperor then ordered Yingju to govern Gansu with Shaanxi's commanders and brigades under his control and promoted him to Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 嘗募巴爾楚克回戶治多蘭溝渠，墾喀喇沙爾以西各台，又增置兵備道、總兵，分駐阿克蘇、葉爾羌二城，逐為重鎮。

translations.literal: He once recruited Balchuk Muslim households to manage the Dolan canal, opened fields on the various stations west of Karashahr, and additionally established a military preparations circuit and regional commanders stationed at Aksu and Yarkand, which gradually became major garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: He once recruited Balchuk Muslim households to manage the Dolan canal and open fields on the stations west of Karashahr. He also added a military preparations circuit and regional commanders stationed at Aksu and Yarkand, which gradually became major garrisons.

sentences.zh: 應琚奏辦屯墾，遣兵購畜，部署紛煩；

translations.literal: Yingju memorialized on organizing colonization, sent troops to purchase livestock, and his deployments were numerous and troublesome;
translations.idiomatic: Yingju memorialized on organizing colonization, sent troops to purchase livestock, and his deployments grew numerous and troublesome.

sentences.zh: 至是，疏自言其非，請因利乘便規久遠。

translations.literal: at this point he memorialized acknowledging his errors and asked to take advantage of circumstances and plan for the long term.
translations.idiomatic: At this point he memorialized acknowledging his errors and asked to take advantage of circumstances and plan for the long term.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納，下其疏示中外。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised and accepted it and circulated his memorial within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended the advice and circulated his memorial within and outside the court.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，移駐肅州，拜東閣大學士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he moved his headquarters to Suzhou and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he moved his headquarters to Suzhou and was appointed Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，緬甸大入邊，滇事棘。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year Burma invaded the border on a large scale and affairs in Yunnan became critical.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Burma invaded the frontier on a large scale and affairs in Yunnan became critical.

sentences.zh: 緬酋莽達拉自為木梳長所篡，擊敗貴家木邦，貴酋宮裹雁奔孟連。

translations.literal: The Burmese ruler Mang Dala had himself been usurped by the Mushu chief; he defeated the Gui family's Mobang, and the Gui chieftain Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese ruler Mang Dala had himself been usurped by the Mushu chief. He defeated the Gui family's Mobang, and the Gui chieftain Gong Guyan fled to Menglian.

sentences.zh: 時應琚子重穀為永昌知府，誘殺之，木酋亦走。

translations.literal: At the time Yingju's son Chonggu was prefect of Yongchang; he lured Gong Guyan and killed him, and the Mushu chieftain also fled.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Yingju's son Chonggu was prefect of Yongchang. He lured Gong Guyan and killed him, and the Mushu chieftain also fled.

sentences.zh: 緬益橫，入犯思茅。

translations.literal: Burma grew still more overbearing and invaded Simao.
translations.idiomatic: Burma grew still more overbearing and invaded Simao.

sentences.zh: 上移應珺雲貴總督視師。

translations.literal: The court transferred Yingju to Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou to take command.
translations.idiomatic: The court transferred Yingju to governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou to take command in person.

sentences.zh: 應琚至楚雄，緬人漸退，師乘間收復。

translations.literal: When Yingju reached Chuxiong the Burmese gradually withdrew, and the army seized the interval to recover lost ground.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingju reached Chuxiong the Burmese gradually withdrew, and the army seized the interval to recover lost ground.

sentences.zh: 應琚往孟良、整賣正經界，集流亡，釐戶口，定賦稅，而令召丙、叭先俸分據之，請賞給三品指揮使。

translations.literal: Yingju went to Mengliang and Zhengmai to rectify the boundaries, gathered displaced people, sorted household registers, fixed tax levies, and ordered Zhao Bing and Ba Xianfeng to hold separate territories; he requested that they be rewarded with the rank of third-grade director.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju went to Mengliang and Zhengmai to rectify the boundaries, gathered displaced people, sorted household registers, fixed tax levies, and ordered Zhao Bing and Ba Xianfeng to hold separate territories. He requested that they be rewarded with the rank of third-grade director.

sentences.zh: 上以為能，賜珍物，官其孫茂齡藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: The Emperor regarded this as capable conduct, bestowed precious objects, and appointed his grandson Maoling a Blue-Plume Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor regarded this as capable conduct, bestowed precious objects, and appointed his grandson Maoling a Blue-Plume Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 又使人誘致孟密、孟養、蠻暮令獻地，實則地懸緬境，內附特空言。

translations.literal: He also sent men to induce Mengmi, Mengyang, and Manmu to offer territory, but in fact the lands hung on the Burmese frontier and their submission inward was only empty talk.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent men to induce Mengmi, Mengyang, and Manmu to offer territory, but in fact those lands lay on the Burmese frontier and their inward submission was only empty talk.

sentences.zh: 諸將希應琚指，爭謂緬勢孤，易攻取。

translations.literal: The generals, hoping to please Yingju, all contended that Burma was isolated and easy to attack and seize.
translations.idiomatic: The generals, hoping to please Yingju, all insisted that Burma was isolated and easy to attack and seize.

sentences.zh: 應琚初猶弗聽，曰：「吾官至一品，年逾七十，復何所求，而以貪功開邊釁乎？

translations.literal: At first Yingju still would not listen, saying: "My office has reached the first rank, I am past seventy—what more is there to seek, that I should open a frontier conflict from greed for merit?"
translations.idiomatic: At first Yingju still would not listen. He said, "My office has reached the first rank and I am past seventy. What more is there to seek, that I should open a frontier conflict from greed for merit?"

sentences.zh: 」副將趙宏榜慫恿之，遂下道、鎮、府、州合議，亦謂寇勢大，邊釁不可開，總兵烏爾登額阻尤力，應琚滋不懌。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Zhao Hongbang egged him on; he then convened the circuit, garrison, prefecture, and department for joint deliberation, and they too said the enemy's strength was great and a frontier conflict must not be opened; Regional Commander Wu Erdenge opposed most forcefully, and Yingju grew still more displeased.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Zhao Hongbang egged him on. He then convened the circuit, garrison, prefecture, and department for joint deliberation, and they too said the enemy's strength was great and a frontier conflict must not be opened. Regional Commander Wu Erdenge opposed most forcefully, and Yingju grew still more displeased.

sentences.zh: 永昌知府陳大呂懼更初議，應琚乃往永昌受降，並為文檄緬，侈言水陸軍五十萬陳境上，不降即進討。

translations.literal: Yongchang Prefect Chen Dalü feared a change from the original plan; Yingju therefore went to Yongchang to accept surrender and also drafted a proclamation to Burma exaggerating that five hundred thousand troops by land and water were arrayed on the border and that if they did not surrender an advance would be made.
translations.idiomatic: Yongchang Prefect Chen Dalü feared a change from the original plan. Yingju therefore went to Yongchang to accept surrender and also drafted a proclamation to Burma exaggerating that five hundred thousand troops by land and water were arrayed on the border and that if they did not submit, an advance would be made.

sentences.zh: 緬遂大發兵溯金沙江而上。

translations.literal: Burma therefore mobilized a large force and advanced up the Jinsha River.
translations.idiomatic: Burma therefore mobilized a large force and advanced up the Jinsha River.

sentences.zh: 其時宏榜頓新街，卻走。

translations.literal: At that time Hongbang was stationed at Xinjie and retreated.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hongbang was stationed at Xinjie and retreated.

sentences.zh: 應琚聞警即遘疾，上命楊廷璋往代，遣侍衛福靈安攜御醫往診；

translations.literal: When Yingju heard the alarm he immediately fell ill; the Emperor ordered Yang Tingzhang to replace him and sent Bodyguard Fuling'an with an imperial physician to examine him;
translations.idiomatic: When Yingju heard the alarm he immediately fell ill. The Emperor ordered Yang Tingzhang to replace him and sent Bodyguard Fuling'an with an imperial physician to examine him.

sentences.zh: 並諭其子江蘇按察使重英、寶慶知府重穀省視。

translations.literal: he also instructed his son, Jiangsu Provincial Judge Chongying, and his son Baqing Prefect Chonggu to go and visit him.
translations.idiomatic: He also instructed his son, Jiangsu Provincial Judge Chongying, and his son Baqing Prefect Chonggu to go and visit him.

sentences.zh: 比廷璋至而疾已愈，乃令諸軍進擊，總兵硃崙出鐵壁關，攻楞木，不克，寇勢益張。

translations.literal: By the time Tingzhang arrived the illness had already abated; he then ordered the armies to advance. Regional Commander Zhu Lun came out through Tiebi Pass to attack Lengmu but could not take it, and the enemy's momentum grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: By the time Tingzhang arrived the illness had already abated. He then ordered the armies to advance. Regional Commander Zhu Lun came out through Tiebi Pass to attack Lengmu but could not take it, and the enemy's momentum grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 提督李時升告急，應琚不報。

translations.literal: Provincial Commander Li Shisheng reported urgency, but Yingju did not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Provincial Commander Li Shisheng reported urgency, but Yingju did not respond.

sentences.zh: 緬陽議款，遂以楞木大捷入告，而緬已漸入戶臘撒。

translations.literal: The Burmese feigned willingness to negotiate peace; he therefore reported a great victory at Lengmu, while Burma had already gradually entered Hulu Sa.
translations.idiomatic: The Burmese feigned willingness to negotiate peace. He therefore reported a great victory at Lengmu, while Burma had already gradually entered Hulu Sa.

sentences.zh: 時總兵劉德成擁兵幹崖，飲酒高會，時升屢趣罔應。

translations.literal: At the time Regional Commander Liu Decheng held troops at Ganyai, drinking and feasting at leisure; Shisheng repeatedly urged him but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Regional Commander Liu Decheng held troops at Ganyai, drinking and feasting at leisure. Shisheng repeatedly urged him but received no response.

sentences.zh: 應琚遣緬寧通判富森持令箭督戰，德成始抵盞達。

translations.literal: Yingju sent Miannie Subprefect Fusen with a command arrow to supervise the battle; only then did Decheng reach Zanda.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju sent Miannie Subprefect Fusen with a command arrow to supervise the battle. Only then did Decheng reach Zanda.

sentences.zh: 緬懼擊其後，潛引去，應琚仍以捷聞。

translations.literal: Burma feared an attack from the rear and quietly withdrew; Yingju still reported it as a victory.
translations.idiomatic: Burma feared an attack from the rear and quietly withdrew. Yingju still reported it as a victory.

sentences.zh: 緬甸復入猛卯，參將哈國興等引還，砲械多遺失，應琚又報捷；

translations.literal: Burma again entered Mengmao; Colonel Ha Guoxing and others led the troops back, and much artillery and equipment was lost; Yingju again reported a victory;
translations.idiomatic: Burma again entered Mengmao. Colonel Ha Guoxing and others led the troops back, and much artillery and equipment was lost. Yingju again reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 並傳令硃崙兼剿撫，陰示以和蕆事，緬果累乞和。

translations.literal: he also transmitted an order that Zhu Lun should combine suppression and pacification and secretly indicated that peace would conclude affairs; Burma indeed repeatedly begged for peace.
translations.idiomatic: He also transmitted an order that Zhu Lun should combine suppression and pacification and secretly indicated that peace would conclude affairs. Burma indeed repeatedly begged for peace.

sentences.zh: 逾歲，奏言：「緬甸酋弟卜坑率聶渺遮乞款附，懇予蠻暮、新街互市。

translations.literal: After more than a year he memorialized, saying: "The Burmese ruler's younger brother Bokeng led Ni Miaozhe to beg to submit and plead for trade at Manmu and Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he memorialized, saying, "The Burmese ruler's younger brother Bokeng led Ni Miaozhe to beg to submit and plead for trade at Manmu and Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 」上察其偽，數訶責。

translations.literal: " The Emperor perceived the deception and repeatedly reproached him.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor perceived the deception and repeatedly reproached him.

sentences.zh: 嗣木邦告警，國興軍抵蠻暮，寇★K4退，應琚又以復新街奏。

translations.literal: Later Mobang raised the alarm; Guoxing's army reached Manmu and the bandits retreated; Yingju again memorialized on recovering Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: Later Mobang raised the alarm. Guoxing's army reached Manmu and the enemy retreated. Yingju again memorialized on recovering Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 上視所進地圖，疑寇既屢敗，何以尚據內地土司境，降旨駁詰。

translations.literal: The Emperor looked at the map submitted and doubted that if the bandits had been repeatedly defeated, why they still held territory within the inner native chieftaincies; he issued an edict to refute and question him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor looked at the map submitted and doubted that if the enemy had been repeatedly defeated, why they still held territory within the inner native chieftaincies. He issued an edict to refute and question him.

sentences.zh: 會福靈安先被命廉軍事，具言宏榜諸人失守狀，應琚亦劾德成等遲留不進，於是俱逮問，而以楊寧為提督，且以應琚不勝任，召明瑞代統其軍。

translations.literal: It happened that Fuling'an had already been ordered to investigate military affairs and detailed how Hongbang and the others had lost their posts; Yingju also impeached Decheng and the others for lingering and not advancing; thereupon all were arrested and questioned, Yang Ning was made provincial commander, and because Yingju was incompetent, Ming Rui was summoned to take command of his army.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Fuling'an had already been ordered to investigate military affairs and detailed how Hongbang and the others had lost their posts. Yingju also impeached Decheng and the others for lingering and not advancing. Thereupon all were arrested and questioned, Yang Ning was made provincial commander, and because Yingju was incompetent, Ming Rui was summoned to take command of his army.

sentences.zh: 明瑞至，首發其欺罔罪，謂誤木緬別為一事尤妄誕，鄂寧亦糾其掩敗為勝。

translations.literal: When Ming Rui arrived he first exposed his crime of deception and said that mistaking Mushu and Burma as separate matters was especially absurd; E'ning also impeached him for masking defeat as victory.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming Rui arrived he first exposed his crime of deception and said that mistaking Mushu and Burma as separate matters was especially absurd. E'ning also impeached him for masking defeat as victory.

sentences.zh: 應琚恐，乃上言大舉徵緬，調湖廣、川、滇軍五萬，五路並進，請敕暹羅夾攻，朝論皆斥之。

translations.literal: Yingju feared and therefore memorialized a great campaign against Burma, calling up fifty thousand troops from Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan to advance on five routes and asking that Siam be ordered to attack from both sides; court opinion all rejected it.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju grew afraid and therefore memorialized a great campaign against Burma, calling up fifty thousand troops from Huguang, Sichuan, and Yunnan to advance on five routes and asking that Siam be ordered to attack from both sides. Court opinion rejected it all.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詔逮問，賜死。

translations.literal: Before long an edict ordered his arrest and questioning; he was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Before long an edict ordered his arrest and questioning. He was granted death.

sentences.zh: 重穀亦坐笞殺人，棄市。

translations.literal: Chonggu was also punished for beating a man to death and was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggu was also punished for beating a man to death and was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 重英初至雲南，隱以監軍自居，嗣為鄂寧所劾，命以知府從軍。

translations.literal: When Chongying first reached Yunnan he implicitly regarded himself as military supervisor; afterward he was impeached by E'ning and was ordered to follow the army as a prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When Chongying first reached Yunnan he implicitly regarded himself as military supervisor. Afterward he was impeached by E'ning and was ordered to follow the army as a prefect.

sentences.zh: 明年，軍士患飢，緬嗛詐媾和，參贊珠魯訥遣重英往報，被執。

translations.literal: The next year the soldiers suffered hunger; Burma pretended willingness to negotiate peace; Counselor Zhulun'e sent Chongying to reply and he was seized.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the soldiers suffered hunger. Burma pretended willingness to negotiate peace. Counselor Zhulun'e sent Chongying to reply and he was seized.

sentences.zh: 上以重英且降緬，下其子長齡獄。

translations.literal: The Emperor thought Chongying was about to surrender to Burma and imprisoned his son Changling.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thought Chongying was about to surrender to Burma and imprisoned his son Changling.

sentences.zh: 已，緬歸俘卒，賚貝葉書，附重英書乞罷兵，拒弗納。

translations.literal: Later Burma returned captive soldiers and sent a palm-leaf letter, attaching a letter from Chongying begging to cease military operations; it was refused.
translations.idiomatic: Later Burma returned captive soldiers and sent a palm-leaf letter, attaching a letter from Chongying begging to cease military operations. The court refused.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，緬出都司蘇爾相議和，仍弗許。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year Burma sent out Director Su Erxiang to negotiate peace, but it was still not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year Burma sent out Director Su Erxiang to negotiate peace, but the court still would not permit it.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，緬聞暹羅受封，乃款關求貢，並還重英。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year Burma heard that Siam had received investiture and therefore opened the border to seek tribute and also returned Chongying.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-third year Burma learned that Siam had received investiture from the court. It then opened the border to seek tribute and also returned Chongying.

sentences.zh: 重英陷緬後，獨居佛寺逾二十年，未改中國衣冠。

translations.literal: After Chongying fell into Burma's hands he lived alone in a Buddhist temple for more than twenty years and never changed his Chinese dress.
translations.idiomatic: After Chongying was held in Burma he lived alone in a Buddhist temple for more than twenty years and never changed his Chinese dress.

sentences.zh: 上大悅，進道員，釋長齡出獄，比以蘇武之節，御製蘇楊論旌之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was greatly pleased, promoted him to circuit intendant, released Changling from prison, compared him to Su Wu in integrity, and composed the Imperial Essay on Su and Yang to honor him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was greatly pleased. He promoted Chongying to circuit intendant, released Changling from prison, compared him to Su Wu in steadfast loyalty, and composed the Imperial Essay on Su and Yang to honor him.

sentences.zh: 俄，病卒。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he died of illness.

sentences.zh: =蘇爾相=蘇爾相，甘肅靈州人。

translations.literal: =Su Erxiang= Su Erxiang was a native of Lingzhou in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Su Erxiang came from Lingzhou in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 自行伍從征緬甸、金川有勞，累遷雲南奇兵營都司。

translations.literal: From the ranks he followed campaigns against Burma and Jinchuan with merit and was promoted in succession to Director of the Yunnan Irregular Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Rising from the ranks, he took part in campaigns against Burma and Jinchuan with distinction and rose in due course to director of the Yunnan Irregular Battalion.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，雲貴總督彰寶以緬甸表貢久不至，遣爾相齎檄往諭，被留，迫使上書阿桂申表貢之議。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year Governor-General Zhangbao of Yunnan and Guizhou, because Burma's tribute memorial had long failed to arrive, sent Erxiang bearing a proclamation to instruct them; he was detained and forced to write to Agui urging acceptance of the tribute proposal.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year Governor-General Zhangbao of Yunnan and Guizhou, because Burma's tribute memorial had long failed to arrive, sent Erxiang with a proclamation to instruct them. He was detained and forced to write to Agui urging acceptance of the tribute proposal.

sentences.zh: 上謂爾相且降緬，命甘肅疆吏執爾相妻孥致京師，子一、女二死於獄，妻死於道。

translations.literal: The Emperor thought Erxiang was about to surrender to Burma and ordered the Gansu frontier officials to seize Erxiang's wife and children and send them to the capital; one son and two daughters died in prison and his wife died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thought Erxiang was about to surrender to Burma and ordered the Gansu frontier officials to seize his wife and children and send them to the capital. One son and two daughters died in prison, and his wife died on the road.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，緬始送爾相還。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year Burma at last sent Erxiang back.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year Burma at last sent Erxiang back.

sentences.zh: 上命阿桂傳諭，令其詣京師，引見，授游擊，賜詩亦比以蘇武。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Agui to transmit instructions and summon him to the capital for audience; he was appointed Brigade Commander and the bestowed poem likewise compared him to Su Wu.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Agui to transmit instructions and summon him to the capital for an audience. He was appointed brigade commander, and the poem bestowed on him likewise compared him to Su Wu.

sentences.zh: 累遷騰越鎮總兵，兼署雲南提督。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to regional commander of Tengyue Garrison and concurrently acted as provincial commander of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose in due course to regional commander of Tengyue Garrison and concurrently acted as provincial commander of Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: =明瑞=明瑞，字筠亭，富察氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人，承恩公富文子。

translations.literal: =Ming Rui= Ming Rui, styled Yunting, of the Fuca clan, was a Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Manchu Banner, son of Duke Fuwen of Chengen.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui, whose style was Yunting, belonged to the Fuca clan and was a Bannerman of the Bordered Yellow Manchu Banner, the son of Duke Fuwen of Chengen.

sentences.zh: 自官學生襲爵。

translations.literal: From student of the Imperial Academy he inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited his title from the Imperial Academy studentship.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十一年，師徵阿睦爾撒納，明瑞以副都統銜授領隊大臣，有功，擢戶部侍郎，授參贊大臣，於公爵加「毅勇」字，號承恩毅勇公。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned against Amursana, Ming Rui was appointed leading commander with the rank of Vice Commander-in-Chief; he had merit, was promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue, appointed Counselor, and to his ducal title was added the characters "Yi Yong"; his title was Duke of Chengen, Yi Yong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned against Amursana, Ming Rui was appointed leading commander with the rank of vice commander-in-chief. He distinguished himself, was promoted to vice minister of revenue and appointed counselor, and the characters Yi Yong were added to his ducal title, making him Duke of Chengen, Yi Yong.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，師徵霍集占，復有功，賜雙眼花翎，加雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, when the army campaigned against Huojizhan, he again had merit and was bestowed double-eyed peacock feathers and an hereditary Yunqiwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, when the army campaigned against Huojizhan, he again distinguished himself and was bestowed double-eyed peacock feathers and an hereditary Yunqiwei fief.

sentences.zh: 師還，圖形紫光閣，擢正白旗漢軍都統。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; he was promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Plain White Han Military Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor. He was promoted to commander-in-chief of the Plain White Han Military Banner.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，出為伊犁將軍，進加騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year he went out as Military Governor of Yili and was further given an hereditary Qiduwei fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year he was appointed military governor of Yili and was further given an hereditary Qiduwei fief.

sentences.zh: 三十年二月，烏什回為亂，駐烏什副都統素誠自戕，亂回推小伯克賴黑木圖拉為渠，拒守。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Wushi rebelled; Vice Commander-in-Chief Sucheng, stationed at Wushi, killed himself; the rebel Muslims made the petty beg Laheimitula leader and resisted behind the walls.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirtieth year the Muslims of Wushi rebelled. Vice Commander-in-Chief Sucheng, stationed at Wushi, killed himself. The rebels made the petty beg Laheimitula their leader and held the city against attack.

sentences.zh: 明瑞遣副都統觀音保往討，而帥師繼其後。

translations.literal: Ming Rui sent Vice Commander-in-Chief Guanyinbao to attack while he himself led the army after him.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui sent Vice Commander-in-Chief Guanyinbao to attack while he himself led the main force after him.

sentences.zh: 烏什回二千餘出禦，明瑞與觀音保力戰破之，奪砲台七。

translations.literal: More than two thousand Wushi Muslims came out to resist; Ming Rui and Guanyinbao fought fiercely and broke them, capturing seven batteries.
translations.idiomatic: More than two thousand Wushi Muslims came out to resist. Ming Rui and Guanyinbao fought fiercely, broke them, and captured seven batteries.

sentences.zh: 賊入城，師合圍。

translations.literal: The bandits entered the city and the army surrounded it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels entered the city and the army surrounded it.

sentences.zh: 明瑞疏陳素誠狂縱激變，及參贊納世通虐回民，阻援師，副都統弁塔哈掩敗妄奏諸狀，上令尚書阿桂至軍，按誅納世通、弁塔哈。

translations.literal: Ming Rui memorialized in detail that Sucheng's arrogance and license had provoked the uprising, that Counselor Nashitong had abused the Muslim people and blocked relief troops, and that Vice Commander-in-Chief Biantaha had masked defeat and falsely reported; the Emperor ordered Minister Agui to the army and had Nashitong and Biantaha executed after investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui memorialized in detail that Sucheng's arrogance and license had provoked the uprising, that Counselor Nashitong had abused the Muslim people and blocked relief troops, and that Vice Commander-in-Chief Biantaha had masked defeat and falsely reported. The Emperor ordered Minister Agui to the army and had Nashitong and Biantaha executed after investigation.

sentences.zh: 賊夜襲我軍，我軍诇知之，預為備，射賴黑木圖拉殪，賊擁其父額色木圖拉為渠。

translations.literal: The bandits raided the army by night; the army learned of it through scouts and made preparations in advance; Laheimitula was shot dead; the bandits made his father Esemitula leader.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels raided the army by night. Scouts warned them in advance and preparations were made. Laheimitula was shot dead, and the rebels made his father Esemitula their leader.

sentences.zh: 明瑞以兵六百餘夜攜雲梯薄其城，不克，則毀其堞，且斷汲道。

translations.literal: Ming Rui with more than six hundred men at night carried scaling ladders close to the city but could not take it; he then destroyed the parapets and cut off the water supply.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui took more than six hundred men by night with scaling ladders close to the walls but could not take the city. He then destroyed the parapets and cut off the water supply.

sentences.zh: 賊待阿富汗援不至，乃縛獻額色木圖拉等四十二人降，明瑞悉斬之，其脅從及婦稚萬餘送伊犁。

translations.literal: The bandits, waiting for Afghan aid that did not arrive, then bound and presented Esemitula and forty-one others to surrender; Ming Rui executed them all and sent more than ten thousand coerced followers, women, and children to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: Waiting for Afghan aid that never arrived, the rebels bound and presented Esemitula and forty-one others to surrender. Ming Rui executed them all and sent more than ten thousand coerced followers, women, and children to Yili.

sentences.zh: 烏什平。

translations.literal: Wushi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Wushi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 上以明瑞得渠魁，未詳鞫為亂狀，亂回至圍急始縛獻首惡，不可輕宥，所措置皆不當，與阿桂同下部議，奪職，命留任。

translations.literal: The Emperor thought that although Ming Rui had obtained the ringleader, he had not thoroughly investigated the circumstances of the rebellion, that the rebel Muslims had only bound and presented the chief culprit when the siege grew desperate and could not be lightly pardoned, and that all his arrangements were improper; he and Agui were together referred to the ministry for deliberation, stripped of office, and ordered to remain at their posts.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor held that although Ming Rui had obtained the ringleader, he had not thoroughly investigated the circumstances of the rebellion, that the rebels had only bound and presented the chief culprit when the siege grew desperate and could not be lightly pardoned, and that all his arrangements were improper. He and Agui were referred to the ministry for deliberation, stripped of office, and ordered to remain at their posts.

sentences.zh: 旋條上善後事，如所請。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he submitted items on post-pacification affairs, and they were carried out as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he submitted proposals on post-pacification affairs, and they were carried out as requested.

sentences.zh: 是時緬甸為亂犯邊，總督劉藻戰屢敗，自殺。

translations.literal: At this time Burma was in rebellion and invaded the border; Governor Liu Zao was repeatedly defeated in battle and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Burma was in rebellion and invaded the frontier. Governor Liu Zao was repeatedly defeated in battle and killed himself.

sentences.zh: 大學士楊應琚代為總督，師久無功，賜死。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yang Yingju replaced him as governor-general; the army was long without success and he was granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yang Yingju replaced him as governor-general. The army was long without success, and he was granted death.

sentences.zh: 三十二年二月，命明瑞以雲貴總督兼兵部尚書，經略軍務。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-second year Ming Rui was ordered to be Governor-General of Yunnan and Guizhou and concurrently Minister of War to direct military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the thirty-second year Ming Rui was ordered to serve as governor-general of Yunnan and Guizhou and concurrently minister of war to direct military affairs.

sentences.zh: 明瑞議大軍出永昌、騰越攻宛頂、木邦為正兵，遣參贊額爾登額出北路，自猛密攻老官屯，會於阿瓦。

translations.literal: Ming Rui planned that the main army should advance from Yongchang and Tengyue to attack Wanding and Mobang as the principal force, send Counselor Erdenge by the northern route from Mengmi to attack Laoguantun, and meet at Ava.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui planned that the main army should advance from Yongchang and Tengyue to attack Wanding and Mobang as the principal force, while Counselor Erdenge would take the northern route from Mengmi to attack Laoguantun, the two columns meeting at Ava.

sentences.zh: 十一月，至宛頂，進攻木邦，賊遁，留參贊珠魯訥、按察使楊重英守之，率兵萬餘渡錫箔江攻蠻結。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he reached Wanding and advanced to attack Mobang; the bandits fled; he left Counselor Zhulun'e and Provincial Judge Yang Chongying to guard it and led more than ten thousand troops across the Xibo River to attack Manjie.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he reached Wanding and advanced to attack Mobang. The enemy fled. He left Counselor Zhulun'e and Provincial Judge Yang Chongying to guard the place and led more than ten thousand troops across the Xibo River to attack Manjie.

sentences.zh: 寇二萬，立十六寨，寨外浚溝，溝外又環以木柵，列象陣為伏兵。

translations.literal: The enemy numbered twenty thousand, established sixteen stockades, dug ditches outside the stockades, and ringed them further with wooden palisades, arraying elephant formations as ambush troops.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy numbered twenty thousand. They established sixteen stockades, dug ditches outside them, ringed the ditches with wooden palisades, and arrayed elephant formations as ambush troops.

sentences.zh: 明瑞統兵居中，領隊大臣扎拉豐阿、李全據東山梁，觀音保、長青據西山梁。

translations.literal: Ming Rui commanded the army in the center; Leading Commander Zhala Feng'a and Li Quan held the eastern hill ridge; Guanyinbao and Chang Qing held the western hill ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui commanded the army in the center. Leading Commander Zhala Feng'a and Li Quan held the eastern hill ridge, while Guanyinbao and Chang Qing held the western hill ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊突陣西出，觀音保、長青力戰，明瑞督中軍進，殺賊二百餘，賊退保柵。

translations.literal: The bandits burst from the western wing of the formation; Guanyinbao and Chang Qing fought fiercely; Ming Rui directed the central army forward and killed more than two hundred bandits; the bandits retreated to hold the palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy burst from the western wing of the formation. Guanyinbao and Chang Qing fought fiercely while Ming Rui directed the central army forward and killed more than two hundred of the enemy. The rebels retreated to hold the palisades.

sentences.zh: 明瑞令分兵為十二隊，身先陷陣，目傷，猶指揮不少挫。

translations.literal: Ming Rui ordered the army divided into twelve companies, took the lead in storming the formation himself, was wounded in the eye, yet directed operations without slackening.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui divided the army into twelve companies and took the lead in storming the formation himself. He was wounded in the eye yet continued to direct operations without slackening.

sentences.zh: 賊陣中群象反奔，我兵毀柵進，無不一當百。

translations.literal: The elephants in the enemy formation turned and fled; our troops destroyed the palisades and advanced, each man fighting as if he were a hundred.
translations.idiomatic: The elephants in the enemy formation turned and fled. Our troops destroyed the palisades and advanced, each man fighting as if he were a hundred.

sentences.zh: 有貴州兵王連者，舞藤牌躍入陣，眾從之，縱橫擊殺，馘二十餘，俘三十有四，賊遁走。

translations.literal: There was a Guizhou soldier named Wang Lian who danced with rattan shields and leaped into the formation; the masses followed him, striking and killing at will; they took more than twenty heads and thirty-four captives, and the bandits fled.
translations.idiomatic: A Guizhou soldier named Wang Lian danced with rattan shields and leaped into the enemy ranks. The troops followed him, striking and killing at will. They took more than twenty heads and thirty-four captives, and the enemy fled.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，上大悅，封一等誠嘉毅勇公，賜黃帶、寶石頂、四團龍補服，原襲承恩公畀其弟奎林。

translations.literal: When victory was reported the Emperor was greatly pleased, enfeoffed him as Duke of the First Rank, Sincere and Commendable, Yi Yong, bestowed yellow belts, a jeweled finial, and a four-dragon roundlet surcoat, and transferred the original Chengen ducal title to his younger brother Kuilin.
translations.idiomatic: When victory was reported the Emperor was greatly pleased. He enfeoffed Ming Rui as Duke of the First Rank, Sincere and Commendable, Yi Yong, bestowed a yellow belt, a jeweled finial, and a four-dragon roundlet surcoat, and transferred the original Chengen ducal title to his younger brother Kuilin.

sentences.zh: 扎拉豐阿、觀音保勸明瑞乘勝罷兵，明瑞不可。

translations.literal: Zhala Feng'a and Guanyinbao urged Ming Rui to cease military operations while victory was at hand; Ming Rui would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Zhala Feng'a and Guanyinbao urged Ming Rui to halt operations while victory was at hand. Ming Rui would not agree.

sentences.zh: 師復進，十二月，次革龍，地逼天生橋渡口，賊踞山巔立柵。

translations.literal: The army advanced again; in the twelfth month it halted at Gelong, where the ground pressed close to the Tiansheng Bridge crossing; the bandits held the mountain crest and erected palisades.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced again. In the twelfth month it halted at Gelong, where the ground pressed close to the Tiansheng Bridge crossing. The enemy held the mountain crest and erected palisades.

sentences.zh: 明瑞令別軍出大道，若將奪渡口，而督軍從間道繞至天生橋上游，乘霧徑渡，進據山梁。

translations.literal: Ming Rui ordered a separate force out on the main road as if to seize the crossing, while he himself directed the army by a hidden path around to the upper reaches of the Tiansheng Bridge, crossed directly in the fog, and advanced to hold the mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui ordered a separate force out on the main road as if to seize the crossing, while he himself led the army by a hidden path to the upper reaches of the Tiansheng Bridge, crossed directly in the fog, and seized the mountain ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊驚潰，浮馘二千餘。

translations.literal: The bandits fled in panic; bodies floating in the river numbered more than two thousand.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy fled in panic. More than two thousand bodies floated in the river.

sentences.zh: 復進至象孔，糧垂罄，欲退，慮額爾登額師已入，聞猛籠土司糧富，且地近猛密，冀通北路軍消息，乃移軍猛籠。

translations.literal: Advancing again to Xiangkong, provisions were nearly exhausted and he wished to withdraw, but he feared Erdenge's army had already entered; hearing that the Menglong native chieftaincy was rich in grain and lay near Mengmi, he hoped to open communication with the northern-route army and therefore moved the army to Menglong.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing again to Xiangkong, provisions were nearly exhausted and he wished to withdraw, but he feared Erdenge's army had already entered. Hearing that the Menglong native chieftaincy was rich in grain and lay near Mengmi, he hoped to open communication with the northern-route army and therefore moved his forces to Menglong.

sentences.zh: 賊尾我軍後，至章子壩，我軍且戰且行。

translations.literal: The bandits followed behind the army; at Zhangziba our troops fought while marching.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy followed behind the army. At Zhangziba our troops fought while marching.

sentences.zh: 明瑞及觀音保等殿，日行不三十里，至猛籠已歲除，土司避匿，發窖粟二萬餘石。

translations.literal: Ming Rui and Guanyinbao and the others brought up the rear, advancing no more than thirty li a day; by the time they reached Menglong the year was ending; the native chieftain had fled and hidden himself; they opened stored grain of more than twenty thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui, Guanyinbao, and the others brought up the rear, advancing no more than thirty li a day. By the time they reached Menglong the year was ending. The native chieftain had fled into hiding, but they opened stored grain of more than twenty thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 駐三日，復引軍趨猛密，人持數升粟，焚其餘積。

translations.literal: After encamping three days they again led the army toward Mengmi; each man carried only a few sheng of grain and burned the remaining stores.
translations.idiomatic: After encamping three days they again led the army toward Mengmi. Each man carried only a few sheng of grain, and they burned the remaining stores.

sentences.zh: 賊躡我軍行，至夕駐營，初相距十餘裡。

translations.literal: The bandits followed the army's march; when the army encamped at evening they were at first more than ten li apart.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy followed the army's march. When the army encamped at evening they were at first more than ten li apart.

sentences.zh: 賊诇我軍飢疲，經蠻化，我軍屯山巔，賊即營山半。

translations.literal: The bandits learned through scouts that the army was hungry and weary; passing through Manhua, our army encamped on the mountain crest and the bandits immediately encamped halfway up the slope.
translations.idiomatic: Scouts told the enemy that the army was hungry and weary. Passing through Manhua, our army encamped on the mountain crest while the enemy immediately encamped halfway up the slope.

sentences.zh: 明瑞謂諸將曰：「賊輕我甚，不一死戰，無焦類矣！

translations.literal: Ming Rui said to the generals: "The bandits despise us greatly; if we do not fight to the death, not one of us will survive!
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui said to the generals, "The enemy despise us utterly. If we do not fight to the death, not one of us will survive!

sentences.zh: 賊識我軍號。

translations.literal: The bandits know our army's signals.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy know our army's signals.

sentences.zh: 明旦我軍傳號，若將起行，則盡出營伏箐待。

translations.literal: At dawn tomorrow let the army pass signals as if about to break camp and march, then all leave camp and lie in ambush in the ravines to wait.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn tomorrow let the army pass signals as if about to break camp and march, then all leave camp and lie in ambush in the ravines to wait.

sentences.zh: 」明旦賊聞聲，蟻附上山。

translations.literal: " At dawn the bandits heard the sounds and swarmed up the mountain like ants.
translations.idiomatic: " At dawn the enemy heard the signals and swarmed up the mountain like ants.

sentences.zh: 我軍突出發槍砲，賊反走，乘之，斬四千有奇。

translations.literal: Our army burst forth, fired muskets and cannon; the bandits turned and fled; pursuing them, they beheaded more than four thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Our army burst forth and fired muskets and cannon. The enemy turned and fled. Pursuing them, our troops beheaded more than four thousand.

sentences.zh: 自此每夜遙屯二十里外，明瑞令休兵六日。

translations.literal: From this time they encamped each night more than twenty li away; Ming Rui ordered the army to rest six days.
translations.idiomatic: From this time they encamped each night more than twenty li away. Ming Rui ordered the army to rest six days.

sentences.zh: 賊柵於要道，我軍攻之不能拔，得波霙人引自桂家銀廠舊址出。

translations.literal: The bandits palisaded the vital road; our army attacked but could not take it; they obtained a Bo'ying guide to lead them out by the old site of the Gui Family Silver Mine.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy palisaded the vital road. Our army attacked but could not break through. A Bo'ying guide led them out by the old site of the Gui Family Silver Mine.

sentences.zh: 上聞明瑞深入，命全師速出。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard that Ming Rui had penetrated deeply, he ordered the entire army to withdraw quickly.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor heard that Ming Rui had penetrated deeply, he ordered the entire army to withdraw quickly.

sentences.zh: 詔未達，三十三年正月，賊攻木邦，副都統珠魯訥師潰自戕，執重英以去。

translations.literal: Before the edict arrived, in the first month of the thirty-third year the bandits attacked Mobang; Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhulun'e's army collapsed and he killed himself; they seized Chongying and took him away.
translations.idiomatic: Before the edict arrived, in the first month of the thirty-third year the enemy attacked Mobang. Vice Commander-in-Chief Zhulun'e's army collapsed and he killed himself. They seized Chongying and took him away.

sentences.zh: 額爾登額出猛密，阻於老官屯，月餘引還。

translations.literal: Erdenge came out from Mengmi but was blocked at Laoguantun; after more than a month he led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: Erdenge came out from Mengmi but was blocked at Laoguantun. After more than a month he led the army back.

sentences.zh: 繞從小隴川緩行，巡撫鄂寧檄援，不應，於是明瑞軍援絕，而賊自木邦、老官屯兩道並集。

translations.literal: Taking a roundabout route through Xiaolongchuan and proceeding slowly, Governor E'ning sent orders to reinforce him but he did not respond; thereupon Ming Rui's army was cut off from relief, while the bandits gathered from both the Mobang and Laoguantun routes.
translations.idiomatic: Taking a roundabout route through Xiaolongchuan and proceeding slowly, Governor E'ning sent orders to reinforce him but he did not respond. Ming Rui's army was thereby cut off from relief while the enemy gathered from both the Mobang and Laoguantun routes.

sentences.zh: 二月，至小猛育，賊麕聚五萬餘。

translations.literal: In the second month they reached Xiaomengyu; the bandits gathered more than fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month they reached Xiaomengyu, where the enemy gathered more than fifty thousand men.

sentences.zh: 我軍食罄，殺馬騾以食；

translations.literal: Our army's food was exhausted and they killed horses and mules for food;
translations.idiomatic: Our army's food was exhausted and they killed horses and mules for food.

sentences.zh: 火藥亦竭，槍砲不能發。

translations.literal: gunpowder was also exhausted and muskets and cannon could not be fired.
translations.idiomatic: Gunpowder was also exhausted, and muskets and cannon could not be fired.

sentences.zh: 明瑞令諸將達興阿、本進忠分隊潰圍出，而自為殿，血戰萬寇中。

translations.literal: Ming Rui ordered the generals Daxing'a and Ben Jinzhong to divide into companies and break out, while he himself brought up the rear, fighting bloody battle amid tens of thousands of bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui ordered the generals Daxing'a and Ben Jinzhong to divide into companies and break out, while he himself brought up the rear, fighting a bloody battle amid tens of thousands of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 扎拉豐阿、觀音保皆死。

translations.literal: Zhala Feng'a and Guanyinbao both died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhala Feng'a and Guanyinbao both died.

sentences.zh: 明瑞負創行二十餘裡，手截辮髮授其僕歸報，而縊於樹下，其僕以木葉掩屍去。

translations.literal: Ming Rui, wounded, went more than twenty li, cut off his queue and hair with his own hand and gave them to his servant to return and report, then hanged himself beneath a tree; his servant covered the corpse with leaves and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Wounded, Ming Rui went more than twenty li, cut off his queue and hair with his own hand and gave them to his servant to return and report, then hanged himself beneath a tree. His servant covered the corpse with leaves and departed.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上震悼，賜祭葬，諡果烈。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported the Emperor was shaken with grief, bestowed sacrificial rites and burial honors, and gave the posthumous title Guolie.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported the Emperor was shaken with grief. He bestowed sacrificial rites and burial honors and gave the posthumous title Guolie.

sentences.zh: 建旌勇祠京師，諸將死事者扎拉豐阿、觀音保、李全、王廷玉，命並祀，珠魯訥以自戕不與。

translations.literal: The Jingyong Shrine was built in the capital; the generals who died in service—Zhala Feng'a, Guanyinbao, Li Quan, and Wang Tingyu—were ordered to be worshiped together; Zhulun'e was excluded because he killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingyong Shrine was built in the capital. The generals who died in service—Zhala Feng'a, Guanyinbao, Li Quan, and Wang Tingyu—were ordered to be worshiped together. Zhulun'e was excluded because he had killed himself.

sentences.zh: 額爾登額及提督譚五格坐失機陷帥，逮詣京師，上廷鞫，用大逆律磔額爾登額，囚其父及女，並族屬戍新疆；

translations.literal: Erdenge and Provincial Commander Tan Wuge were punished for missing their opportunity and causing the commander to fall; they were arrested and brought to the capital; the Emperor tried them at court; by the law of great treason Erdenge was dismembered, his father and daughter imprisoned, and his clan and relatives banished to Xinjiang;
translations.idiomatic: Erdenge and Provincial Commander Tan Wuge were punished for missing their opportunity and causing the commander to fall. They were arrested and brought to the capital. The Emperor tried them at court. By the law of great treason Erdenge was dismembered, his father and daughter imprisoned, and his clan and relatives banished to Xinjiang.

sentences.zh: 譚五格亦棄市，而以其明日祭明瑞及扎拉豐阿、觀音保，上親臨奠。

translations.literal: Tan Wuge was also executed in the marketplace, and on the following day sacrifices were offered to Ming Rui, Zhala Feng'a, and Guanyinbao; the Emperor attended in person.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Wuge was also executed in the marketplace. On the following day sacrifices were offered to Ming Rui, Zhala Feng'a, and Guanyinbao, and the Emperor attended in person.

sentences.zh: 明瑞無子，以奎林子惠倫為嗣，襲爵。

translations.literal: Ming Rui had no son; Kuilin's son Huilun was made heir and inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui had no son. Kuilin's son Huilun was made heir and inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 自侍衛累遷奉宸院卿。

translations.literal: From bodyguard he was promoted in succession to Director of the Imperial Parks Service.
translations.idiomatic: From bodyguard he rose in due course to director of the Imperial Parks Service.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，剿教匪湖北，自荊門、宜城逐賊入南漳山中，賜玉搬指、荷包；

translations.literal: Early in the Jiaqing reign, while suppressing sect rebels in Hubei, he drove the bandits from Jingmen and Yicheng into the mountains of Nanzhang and was bestowed a jade thumb-ring and purse;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign, while suppressing sect rebels in Hubei, he drove the bandits from Jingmen and Yicheng into the mountains of Nanzhang and was bestowed a jade thumb-ring and purse.

sentences.zh: 复逐賊至長坪，射賊渠，殪，餘賊兢集，中槍死，賜白金三千。

translations.literal: he again pursued the bandits to Changping, shot the bandit leader dead, the remaining bandits gathered in alarm, he was struck by a musket ball and died, and three thousand taels of silver were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: He again pursued the bandits to Changping, shot the bandit leader dead, and when the remaining bandits gathered in alarm he was struck by a musket ball and died. Three thousand taels of silver were bestowed in his honor.

sentences.zh: =【論】=論曰：藻起詞科，以廉被主知，陟歷中外。

translations.literal: =Commentary= The commentary says: Zao rose through the examination in letters and was known to the ruler for integrity, ascending through central and outer offices.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Liu rose through the examination in letters and was known to the throne for integrity, ascending through central and provincial offices.

sentences.zh: 應琚持節臨邊，著聲績。

translations.literal: Yingju held the tally and governed the frontier, achieving reputation and merit.
translations.idiomatic: Yingju held imperial commission on the frontier and achieved reputation and merit.

sentences.zh: 要皆不習軍旅，措注失條理，事敗身殉。

translations.literal: Yet in the end none were practiced in military affairs; their arrangements lacked order, affairs failed, and they perished with their bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in the end none were practiced in military affairs. Their arrangements lacked order, affairs failed, and they perished in the attempt.

sentences.zh: 明瑞深入，度敵不可勝，遣諸軍徐出，而躬自血戰，誓死不反顧，功雖不成，忠義凜烈，足以讋敵矣！

translations.literal: Ming Rui penetrated deeply, judged the enemy could not be overcome, sent the armies out slowly, yet fought bloody battle himself, vowing death and never turning back; though merit was not achieved, his loyalty and righteousness were stern and bright, enough to overawe the enemy!
translations.idiomatic: Ming Rui penetrated deeply, judged the enemy could not be overcome, sent the armies out slowly, yet fought the bloody battle himself, vowing death and never turning back. Though success was not achieved, his loyalty and righteousness were stern and bright, enough to overawe the enemy!
